name: 030-voice-clone-custom-from-3sec
description: Voice profile from a 3-second reference WAV. Asserts the resulting profile carries a real 1024-d ECAPA-TDNN x-vector (embedding_state == 'encoded'). Requires a Qwen3-TTS Base checkpoint (the speaker encoder lives in its model.safetensors under speaker_encoder.*).

input_artifacts.notes: 440 Hz sine, amplitude 0.5, 16-bit PCM mono @ 16kHz. Used as the speaker-encoder input; we do not assert anything about the audio content, only that the encoder accepts the format and produces a non-zero embedding. The server resamples to 24 kHz and computes a 128-mel spectrogram before encoding; reference audio must be >= 0.5 s.

ref_outputs.notes: The embedding is the raw ECAPA-TDNN fc output (the reference implementation does NOT L2-normalize; the old norm ~= 1.0 assertion described a scaffold that no longer exists). Without a speaker encoder — i.e. when NV_TTS_TALKER_DIR points at a CustomVoice/VoiceDesign checkpoint, whose safetensors carry no speaker_encoder.* tensors — the server refuses enrollment with 503 code 'no_speaker_encoder' instead of storing a zero vector; there is no placeholder-zeros mode anymore. In that configuration this fixture is skipped.
